# Mechanics

The mechanic tag is the reason this library exists.

Plenty of places will tell you what somebody built. Almost nowhere tells you **what decided
whether it worked** — and that is the part that transfers between domains. A distribution gap
kills an on-chain launch and a developer tool in exactly the same way.

So "show me everything that died of a distribution gap" is a question this library can answer
and most cannot.

## `repeat-demand`

*Observed repeat usage or purchases sustained the product.*

_No idea carries this tag yet._

## `output-correctness`

*The correctness or completeness of produced data decided the result.*

_No idea carries this tag yet._

## `rate-limits`

*A throughput cap was the binding constraint.*

- [Reading thousands of contract values through Multicall3 instead of a block explorer API](https://github.com/lordbasilaiassistant-sudo/idea-library/tree/main/ideas/tooling-infra/multicall-batch-reads) — `shipped`

## `distribution-gap`

*It worked and nobody found it. The classic killer.*

- [A permissionless fee claim that pays nothing because no one has traded](https://github.com/lordbasilaiassistant-sudo/idea-library/tree/main/ideas/crypto-onchain/fee-claim-needs-trading-first) — `inconclusive`
- [Five hundred tokens, one hundred and forty generic names, and zero trading volume](https://github.com/lordbasilaiassistant-sudo/idea-library/tree/main/ideas/crypto-onchain/five-hundred-tokens-zero-volume) — `failed`
- [Launching tokens through an SDK instead of the web UI, and losing every discovery hook](https://github.com/lordbasilaiassistant-sudo/idea-library/tree/main/ideas/crypto-onchain/sdk-launch-discovery-gap) — `failed`
- [We built forty-three paid micro-services and never found a single customer](https://github.com/lordbasilaiassistant-sudo/idea-library/tree/main/ideas/web-saas/forty-three-services-no-customers) — `failed`
